label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 13: Obligations of the trader in the event of withdrawal
6. Except in the situations referred to in point (a), (b) or (c) of paragraph 5, the trader shall, at the request of the consumer, make available to the consumer any content, other than personal data, which was provided or created by the consumer when using the digital content or digital service supplied by the trader.
raw_output: When a customer cancels an online purchase, the business must provide any non-personal content the customer created while using the service. This applies when the customer requests it after returning the product or ending the service.
enrichment: When a customer cancels an online purchase, the business must provide any non-personal content the customer created while using the service. This applies when the customer requests it after returning the product or ending the service.
